verdict.rationale: Linear's own docs show teams can create documents from their home page, attach existing documents to projects and issues, and group them into sections. Documents can also be created and edited on mobile, support rich elements like callouts, and are kept current by Loops with author indicators showing who wrote what. The product positions these docs as PRDs tied to initiatives and roadmaps. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the docs feature, in-depth documentation of real-time co-editing and organization or sharing permissions (evidence is mostly short changelog snippets).
